env.build: the p4-rehost snapshot: origin/main 8813246 via git archive, plus the working tree's uncommitted history fixes (ensure.ts, migrateLand.ts, migrateSource.ts, saveHash.ts) and this session's WorldBundleActions.tsx fix (not on this flow's path), private Vite cacheDir. See ../milestone-rev6-p4-rehost/run.json env.build.
env.apps: A on 9344 ($SCR/udA2, AETHER_TEST_WORLD_PATH=$SCR/files/a2.world), B on 9345 ($SCR/udB2, AETHER_TEST_WORLD_PATH=$SCR/files/b2-import.world); both fresh, both ship aether-land 1.0.0–1.3.0 (base.ts installs every shipped revision on first start). No world service.
env.driver: CDP_PORT=<port> bun scripts/cdp-drive.ts "$(cat <run-NN file>)" from the repo root
env.dialogs: AETHER_TEST_WORLD_PATH answers both .world dialogs with one path, so A's inspect (step 4) runs before A's export (step 7) overwrites that path

model.source: Settings → Model default (OPENAI_API_KEY in the repo .env)
model.calls: A: 1 (the 1.2.0 origin witness, 3332+1142 tokens, 2816 cached); B: 0

steps.what: the physics-99 file (see physics99.ts.txt): a real .world's genesis body with physicsVersion 99, re-signed by a throwaway key as a new one-entry local world, written by buildWorldBundle
steps.command: cd $SCR/tree && bun --tsconfig-override tsconfig.node.json e2e-tools/physics99.ts $SCR/files/b-export1.world $SCR/files/physics99.world; bun run verify-world -- physics99.world; cp physics99.world $SCR/files/a2.world

steps.what: start A (fresh userData; its .world dialogs answer $SCR/files/a2.world)
Settings: English (no world service: this flow never shares)

Worlds → World files → Choose a .world file (AETHER_TEST_WORLD_PATH answers with $SCR/files/a2.world, at this point a copy of physics99.world); the report shows physics-newer and no Bring it in button

actions.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const t = document.body.innerText; if (/problem/.test(t) || /Every check passed/.test(t) || /Error/.test(t)) break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const t = document.body.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('Import a .world'); return t.slice(at, at + 1500) })()

JSON.stringify({ bringItIn: [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Bring it in'), buttons: [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b => b.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean) })

(async () => { const r = await window.seed.bundle.inspect(); return JSON.stringify(r.ok ? { file: r.value?.fileName, physics: r.value?.report.physicsVersion, problems: r.value?.report.problems } : r.error) })()

(async () => { const r = await window.seed.bundle.inspect(); if (!r.ok || r.value === null) return 'no inspect'; const i = await window.seed.bundle.import(r.value.token, 'Ann'); return JSON.stringify(i.ok ? i.value : i.error) })()

steps.what: Worlds → Cartridges: click the aether-land 1.2.0 row (installed on every device by base.ts). The click focuses and confirms the row at once, so it starts a run pinned to 1.2.0 (the recorded 'Play' click found nothing and is dropped here); the land opens and its local-only history is made (genesis on 1.2.0); wait for the origin witness

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 160; i++) { const s = S.useSessionStore.getState(); if (s.screen === 'play' && s.activeInstance) return JSON.stringify({ screen: s.screen, pin: s.activeInstance.instance?.runtimePin ?? null }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'timeout ' + S.useSessionStore.getState().screen })()

repeat.until: (async () => { const H = await import('/history/index.ts'); const n = H.worldNow(); return n !== null && n.chunks['0,0'] !== undefined })()

actions.eval: (async () => { const H = await import('/history/index.ts'); const n = H.worldNow(); return JSON.stringify({ world: n?.world, head: n?.head, cartridge: n?.genesis?.body?.cartridge ?? null, physics: n?.genesis?.body?.physicsVersion ?? null, sequencer: n?.sequencer ?? null, chunks: n && Object.keys(n.chunks) }) })()

steps.what: the co-owner key named in step 7 (a throwaway, not B's)

Add one owner.add to the never-attached 1.2.0 world with window.seed.world.addOwner (the preload call the door's people rows use; a local-only world has no member rows to click), naming a throwaway key that is not B's; then leave Play, Worlds → World files → Export .world (the dialog answers $SCR/files/a2.world, overwriting the physics-99 copy)

actions.eval: (async () => { const H = await import('/history/index.ts'); const n = H.worldNow(); const r = await window.seed.world.addOwner(n.world, 'k6dd3ubd6m3ga5prp5vwrmkll7hwvxtj47lqwkbbrc4b3kptkdlxa'); await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 800)); const m = H.worldNow(); return JSON.stringify({ added: r.ok ? r.value : r.error, head: m.head, owners: Object.keys(m.owners ?? {}), kinds: null }) })()
(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('Worlds on this device'); return t.slice(at, at + 600) })()

(async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) { const t = document.body.innerText; if (/Wrote .*KiB/.test(t) || /Error/.test(t)) break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const t = document.body.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('Worlds on this device'); return t.slice(at, at + 800) })()

steps.what: verify A's export offline; B's dialogs answer a copy of it
steps.command: cp $SCR/files/a2.world a2-120.world; bun run verify-world -- a2-120.world; cp a2-120.world $SCR/files/b2-import.world

steps.what: Settings: English (no world service: this flow never shares)

B (fresh device; 1.3.0 is the newest it ships): Worlds → World files → Choose a .world file (answers $SCR/files/b2-import.world, a copy of A's 1.2.0 export); read the report; name Bo; Bring it in; Play opens

actions.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const t = document.body.innerText; if (/problem/.test(t) || /Every check passed/.test(t) || /Error/.test(t)) break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const t = document.body.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('Import a .world'); return t.slice(at, at + 1500) })()

(() => { const f = [...document.querySelectorAll('input')].find(x => (x.closest('label')?.innerText ?? '').includes('Your name in this world')); if (!f) return 'no name field'; f.focus(); f.select(); return f.value })()

(async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 160; i++) { const s = S.useSessionStore.getState(); if (s.screen === 'play' && s.activeInstance) return { ms: Math.round(performance.now() - window.__t0), screen: s.screen }; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const t = document.body.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('Import a .world'); return 'timeout: ' + t.slice(at, at + 1500) })()

(async () => { const H = await import('/history/index.ts'); const n = H.worldNow(); return JSON.stringify({ world: n?.world, head: n?.head, cartridge: n?.genesis?.body?.cartridge ?? null, physics: n?.genesis?.body?.physicsVersion ?? null, genesisAuthor: n?.genesis?.author ?? null, owners: Object.keys(n?.owners ?? {}), chunks: n && Object.keys(n.chunks), sequencer: n?.sequencer ?? null }) })()

steps.what: read B's disk: histories, instance pin, save's world.json and progress.json, blobs

Reproducibility of the exporter-made genesis pack: B leaves Play, Worlds → World files lists the adopted world (and the kept original), Export .world of the adopted one (answers $SCR/files/b2-import.world; the imported copy is kept as a2-120.world)

actions.eval: (() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('Worlds on this device'); return t.slice(at, at + 800) })()

(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].map(h => h.parentElement).filter(r => r && /You own it/.test(r.innerText)); const b = rows[0] && [...rows[0].querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.innerText.trim() === 'Export .world'); if (!b) return 'no button'; b.click(); return 'clicked Export .world in the owned row' })()

(async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) { const t = document.body.innerText; if (/Wrote .*KiB/.test(t) || /Error/.test(t)) break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const t = document.body.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('Worlds on this device'); return t.slice(at, at + 800) })()
